title: A8 agent output (a8-change-judge)
description: Section 9/A8 'Agent output' line and the a8-change-judge agent file (Appendix B), including its worked examples. Note change_type here includes 'unsure' (the agent's own allowed value) — Section 17.1's change_type list (fact_changed/removed/added/wording_only, no 'unsure') describes the RESOLVED value A9 writes to ncert/change_log.csv after retry/second-opinion/adjudication, not this raw per-run output.

old_fact.description: One line describing what the older book said.

new_fact.description: One line describing what the latest book says.

could_flip_an_answer.description: True if an always/only/all, NOT, count or matching question could have a different answer because of this change.
